name: artlab-01-initial-unobstructed
eval: (() => { const p = document.getElementById('panel').getBoundingClientRect(); const btn = document.getElementById('hideBtn').textContent.trim(); return { scrollY: window.scrollY, panelTop: p.top, panelVisibleInViewport: (p.top < window.innerHeight), btnIcon: btn }; })()

name: artlab-02-scrolled-controls-dock
eval: (() => { document.getElementById('panel').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'instant', block: 'start' }); const p = document.getElementById('panel').getBoundingClientRect(); const btn = document.getElementById('hideBtn').textContent.trim(); return { scrollY: window.scrollY, panelTop: p.top, panelInView: (p.top >= 0 && p.top < window.innerHeight), btnIcon: btn }; })()

name: artlab-03-scrolled-back-to-art
eval: (() => { document.getElementById('panel').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'instant', block: 'start' }); window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'instant' }); const p = document.getElementById('panel').getBoundingClientRect(); return { scrollY: window.scrollY, panelTop: p.top, panelBelowFold: (p.top >= window.innerHeight) }; })()

name: artlab-04-h-shortcut-hidden
eval: (() => { window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'h' })); return { hideUi: document.body.classList.contains('hide-ui'), panelDisplay: getComputedStyle(document.getElementById('panel')).display }; })()

name: artlab-05-narrow-mobile-view
eval: (() => { const p0 = document.getElementById('panel').getBoundingClientRect(); document.getElementById('panel').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'instant', block: 'start' }); const p1 = document.getElementById('panel').getBoundingClientRect(); return { initialPanelTop: p0.top, scrolledPanelTop: p1.top, scrollY: window.scrollY }; })()
